Clause 01 grants use/reproduction/distribution only 'for public health purposes'; clause 04 states 'Any other alteration or modification of the Datasets (including abbreviations, additions, or deletions) may be made only with the prior written authorization of WHO'; clause 05 states 'You will not sell or otherwise transfer the Datasets and/or data contained therein to any third party, except within the Licensed Use.' This release is a substantial alteration (new grain, derived label, row selection), so redistribution without prior written authorization is not established by any WHO instrument we could read. The CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO claim rests on WHO's general publishing copyright page, which the operator's gate 1 explicitly forbids treating as dataset-specific evidence.

scope: 27 published releases: 13 modern, 14 legacy. Anonymous manifest reads only; no bulk CSV downloads or row-overlap measurement.

source_revisits.interpretation: Same complaint database; modern task restricts population and monetary-relief outcome, legacy broad relief task dropped.
Overlapping FDA recall-classification research; modern deferred, legacy food-only task dropped. Distinct from published 510(k) clearance-to-recall prediction.
Same MSHA inspection/violation source family; different outcome: any significant-and-substantial citation versus section-specific citation prediction. Modern deferred, legacy published.

limitations: No matching declared data-file SHA256 across different published dataset IDs; renamed, filtered or transformed copies need not share hashes.
Source revisits identified from candidate descriptions; this is not an exhaustive semantic or row-level overlap audit of every abandoned lead.
Three research repetitions and repeated CLI invocations within the same session are intentional; they are not additional dataset queue admissions.
